evals.prompt: Create a documentation skill named sample-docs from the supplied local test site's llms.txt. The generated SKILL.md must only index downloaded references, and every advertised page must be downloaded with agent-browser. Save it under the requested output directory.
evals.expected_output: A valid generated skill with all llms.txt pages mirrored, a compact reference-only SKILL.md, and a valid manifest.
expectations: The generated SKILL.md has valid name and description frontmatter and contains only documentation-routing content.
Every page advertised by llms.txt exists under references and is linked from SKILL.md.
The manifest records llms.txt discovery and the correct page count.
The source index and manifest identify the llms.txt discovery URL and both downloaded pages.

evals.prompt: Refresh an existing generated documentation skill from the supplied local test site's sitemap.xml. Replace stale previously generated pages, preserve an unrelated notes.md file, and validate the refreshed result.
evals.expected_output: A refreshed sitemap-backed documentation skill whose tracked references are current, unrelated files remain, and all links validate.
expectations: The refreshed manifest records sitemap.xml discovery and the correct current page count.
A stale page tracked by the old manifest is removed.
The unrelated notes.md file is preserved unchanged.
The generated SKILL.md links every current reference with no broken links.
